about: Ticket 731: silhouette cells of each drive look on chassis.drive, on a 4 mm grid, at tiers 1 and 3: outside the rig at rest but inside the undercarriage window [-0.44, -0.48, 0.44, -0.24] (`outsideRigInWindow`, the belt over the gaps between the rollers, allowed), outside both (`outsideRigAndWindow`, must be all zero), and, for the base look, the cells it adds to the tier-1 rig inside the window (`addsToRig`, must be zero); written by check_outline.py.
